old: In Sándor Márai's 'A gyertyák csonkig égnek', the personal rupture between General Henrik and Konrád mirrors the macroeconomic disintegration of the Austro-Hungarian common market. The certainty of gold-standard currencies gave way to hyperinflation and territorial fragmentation, demonstrating how economic collapse dismantles moral and social contracts.
new: In the reading of this lesson, General Henrik and Konrád look back on a world in which prices grew a hundredfold and savings shrank. The scene uses this unit's rates to show how an economic collapse also damages trust. It is a scene written for this course in the spirit of Márai Sándor's novel, not a summary of the book.
